incidents.name: Incident on 2012-04-30 22:54:34 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-04-30 22:54:34 - We're investigating performance problems.
  • 2012-04-30 23:08:40 - Performance is returning to normal. Sorry for the hiccup.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-04-27 21:31:13 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-04-27 21:31:13 - We're investigating reports of a GitHub Pages outage affecting some users.
  • 2012-04-27 21:38:29 - We've isolated the problems with GitHub Pages to users with A records instead of CNAMEs to pages.github.com. We're working to restore service on the original IP, but if you're able to, changing your A record to point to 204.232.175.78 may restore service
  • 2012-04-27 22:22:37 - Service has been restored to all GitHub Pages.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-04-26 04:24:25 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-04-26 04:24:25 - Scheduled fileserver maintenance is underway. https://github.com/blog/1111-fileserver-maintenance-wednesday-night
  • 2012-04-26 05:44:29 - Fileserver maintenance is complete. Thanks for your patience.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-04-24 08:44:10 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-04-24 08:44:10 - One of our fileserver pairs is experiencing connectivity issues. We are investigating.
  • 2012-04-24 08:56:50 - Fileserver is back online.
  • 2012-04-24 09:07:48 - Fileserver pair is stabilizing. All repos should be accessible again.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-04-11 08:55:01 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-04-11 08:55:01 - We're investigating routing problems affecting access to github.com for some networks.
  • 2012-04-11 08:57:36 - Interruptions appear to be isolated to a small percentage of source networks. We're investigating with our upstream providers.
  • 2012-04-11 10:09:29 - We're still investigating a small routing issue with our upstream providers. We'll update the status with more details shortly.
  • 2012-04-11 12:16:13 - We're currently waiting for our upstream providers to correct this network routing issue which is still affecting some of our customers. Sorry for the inconvenience.
  • 2012-04-11 14:07:50 - The routing issue seems to be fixed now. Please contact support if you're still having connectivity problems to github.com

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-04-11 01:45:51 UTC
incidents.message: • 2012-04-11 01:45:51 - We're investigating connectivity problems from a handful of networks with our upstream providers.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-04-09 22:47:44 UTC
incidents.message: • 2012-04-09 22:47:44 - MySQL load spike causing intermittent 500s. Issue is resolved and services are returning to normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-03-30 09:09:32 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-03-30 09:09:32 - We're investigating intermittent issues with git:// protocol clones.
  • 2012-03-30 09:42:28 - git:// clones are back to normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-03-27 18:17:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2012-03-27 18:17:00 - GitHub Pages DNS is changing. Pages may now be served from 204.232.175.78 in addition to 207.97.227.245. Update your firewall rules accordingly!

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-03-16 18:53:10 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-03-16 18:53:10 - GitHub Pages is still impacted by the earlier problems. We'll update again when it's back up.
  • 2012-03-16 19:11:12 - GitHub Pages is up and running again

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-03-16 18:39:08 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-03-16 18:39:08 - Investigating load balancer problems
  • 2012-03-16 18:49:11 - Load balancers are back in working order. We're investigating the cause of the problems now.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-03-16 15:34:51 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-03-16 15:34:51 - Seeing occasional unicorns. We're investigating.
  • 2012-03-16 15:52:05 - We've resolved the issue causing occasional unicorns and performance problems. Sorry for the bumpy morning!

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-03-15 16:20:55 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-03-15 16:20:55 - GitHub Pages is experiencing intermittent connectivity problems, and page builds are delayed as we work through a queue backlog.
  • 2012-03-16 13:36:06 - Experiencing some connectivity errors. Working to stabilize things now.
  • 2012-03-16 13:36:28 - Connectivity should be back to normal, but downloads are still affected.
  • 2012-03-16 14:25:26 - All systems go

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-03-06 16:06:34 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-03-06 16:06:34 - We've briefly disabled the affected fileserver again as recovery is slower than expected.
  • 2012-03-06 16:17:14 - Recovery on the affected fileserver is progressing.
  • 2012-03-06 17:00:30 - We've put the affected fileserver back into service and are monitoring it closely.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-03-06 15:43:19 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-03-06 15:43:19 - We're performing emergency maintenance on a fileserver pair, affecting access to a small percentage of Git repos.
  • 2012-03-06 15:54:49 - Repos on the affected fileserver are now available.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-03-06 06:23:44 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-03-06 06:23:44 - The Pull Requests page is experiencing slow load times due to slow DB queries. Investigating.
  • 2012-03-06 06:47:17 - Some SSH operations are currently failing due to database load. Still investigating.
  • 2012-03-06 07:08:53 - We fixed the MySQL query plan for a slow query and database activity is returning to normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-03-04 08:31:49 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-03-04 08:31:49 - We're preforming emergency maintenance on a fileserver. Access to a small percentage of repos is affected. We'll update with more info shortly!
  • 2012-03-04 09:05:36 - All fileservers are back online.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-03-02 23:27:51 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-03-02 23:27:51 - We're investigating performance problems with GitHub Pages.
  • 2012-03-03 00:02:12 - Pages performance has largely stabilized. We're planning to roll out some performance improvements early next week. Stay tuned!

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-27 13:28:16 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-27 13:28:16 - Investigating connectivity problems. Suspecting another DDoS attack.
  • 2012-02-27 13:38:46 - All services are back to normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-25 22:51:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-25 22:51:00 - Emergency maintenance is being performed on one fileserver pair, affecting access to a small percentage of repos. We'll update when it's back up!
  • 2012-02-25 23:05:42 - All fileservers are back online!

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-25 03:58:04 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-25 03:58:04 - One of our fileserver pairs is down briefly for emergency maintenance.
  • 2012-02-25 04:44:02 - All fileservers are back online.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-23 23:52:23 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-23 23:52:23 - One of our fileservers is offline for emergency maintenance. Should be back up quickly.
  • 2012-02-24 00:02:40 - Maintenance complete!

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-23 13:07:58 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-23 13:07:58 - Investigating connectivity problems
  • 2012-02-23 13:13:41 - We'll be down for a quick second while we put another layer of DDoS defense in place.
  • 2012-02-23 13:24:21 - We're back. We're rolling out even more DDoS protection later today, stay tuned!

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-17 21:21:11 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-17 21:21:11 - The DDoS is at it again. Investigating.
  • 2012-02-17 21:25:52 - Services are returning to normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-17 16:13:03 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-17 16:13:03 - Experiencing load balancer troubles. Investigating.
  • 2012-02-17 16:19:50 - All services have been restored.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-16 00:13:10 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-16 00:13:10 - Tracking down the source of the unicorns now
  • 2012-02-16 00:20:26 - Had to restart MySQL. InnoDB recovery happening now.
  • 2012-02-16 00:26:33 - MySQL is back up. Services are slow, but recovering.
  • 2012-02-16 00:29:41 - Still working to get services fully recovered.
  • 2012-02-16 00:56:21 - Site is recovering, but a small percentage of repos are still unavailable. We're fixing up the routing table now.
  • 2012-02-16 01:40:26 - All repos should be available now. We're still working on fixing the routing table for a handful of gists and enabling a few site features we disabled during the outage.
  • 2012-02-16 02:25:01 - All services have recovered and all features are enabled. Please email support@github.com if you're seeing any issues!

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-14 19:38:16 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-14 19:38:16 - The Nodeload service is down for a small percentage of repositories. We're working to resolve this.
  • 2012-02-14 19:45:11 - All nodeload servers are online and serving requests.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-11 22:47:50 UTC
incidents.message: • 2012-02-11 22:47:50 - We're rolling out some new DDoS prevention strategies today. If you're having trouble reaching GitHub and don't see a current outage reported here, please send support@github.com a note with your IP address. Cheers!

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-11 13:47:15 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-11 13:47:15 - The DDoS is at it again. Investigating.
  • 2012-02-11 13:58:21 - All services have recovered.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-11 00:31:18 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-11 00:31:18 - DDoS has taken us down again. We're investigating.
  • 2012-02-11 00:36:57 - Services have recovered. We're hard at work to improve our defenses.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-10 22:00:29 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-10 22:00:29 - Fighting the DDoS again. We'll post updates as we have them.
  • 2012-02-10 22:07:32 - We have this wave of the attack under control. Sorry for the hiccup, everyone!

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-09 20:59:02 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-09 20:59:02 - We're investigating connectivity problems. More info as we have it.
  • 2012-02-09 21:06:44 - Services are recovering.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-09 14:09:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-09 14:09:00 - We're experiencing network connectivity issues. Investigating.
  • 2012-02-09 14:20:21 - All services are stabilizing.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-08 15:46:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-08 15:46:00 - Investigating more timeouts and unicorns
  • 2012-02-08 15:55:08 - All services are back to normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-08 15:30:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2012-02-08 15:30:00 - Everything is back up. We're looking into what caused the hiccup.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-08 15:19:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-08 15:19:00 - Experiencing network connectivity issues with our host. Currently investigating.
  • 2012-02-08 15:25:00 - A few things didn't come back up properly (such as Git access), still investigating.
  • 2012-02-08 15:28:00 - Everything looks good now.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-07 19:55:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-07 19:55:00 - We're investigating connectivity issues.
  • 2012-02-07 20:05:00 - Service is recovering. We're monitoring things closely.
  • 2012-02-07 20:12:00 - All services have stabilized.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-06 22:19:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-06 22:19:00 - We lost a few cache servers. Things may be slow for a few minutes while they recover.
  • 2012-02-06 23:08:00 - We're still experiencing problems with some of our memcache servers and jobs are backed up. We're hoping to see the queue get back under control in the next few minutes while we continue to investigate the issue.
  • 2012-02-06 23:48:00 - The cache servers have stabilized. We're processing through the backlog of jobs and monitoring things closely.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-04 21:31:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-04 21:31:00 - We're investigating connectivity issues.
  • 2012-02-04 22:04:00 - HTTP and SSH services are experiencing intermittent slowness and timeouts. We are tracking down the issue causing connectivity problems at the load balancer.
  • 2012-02-04 22:46:00 - We've fixed the underlying routing issue. Services are returning to normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-02-02 12:23:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-02-02 12:23:00 - Pages is going down for quick maintenance at 4:45am PST. Downtime expected: < 5 minutes.
  • 2012-02-02 12:45:00 - Pages maintenance is starting now. We'll update again when it's done!
  • 2012-02-02 12:47:00 - Maintenance is going to take a bit longer than expected, unfortunately. Estimated total downtime is now 30 minutes. More updates as we have them!
  • 2012-02-02 13:13:00 - GitHub Pages is back up!
